replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Here's my point of view

Here's the difference between you and me which lead to your ban.

Although my hits on you register with my crosshairs off you (the blood particles show up, and you get damage), I click when my crosshair is over you.

For you, you "click" when you aren't on my hitbox, and the hit registers off my hitbox (the hit registering off my hitbox doesn't really matter, as you can see with my example). SafeAura is defined as this, and that's why you were banned (I didn't ban you by myself, multiple moderators voted).

If you have any more questions as to the reasoning, please let me know. :)
